mapper.select: SELECT t1.id, t1.order_id, t1.product_id, t2.`name` AS product_name, t1.batch_id, t3.batch_no, t1.quantity, t1.price, t1.amount, t1.note, t1.`index`, t1.status, t1.cut_quantity, t1.ship_time FROM zc_sales_order_product t1 LEFT JOIN zc_product t2 ON t1.product_id = t2.id AND t2.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN zc_product_batch t3 ON t1.batch_id = t3.id AND t3.deleted = 0 WHERE t1.deleted = 0 AND t1.order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY t1.id ASC
